FISHING LICENCE · AUSTRIA

Austria fishing licence

Austria normally requires a provincial fishing card or guest card, plus permission for the chosen water. Rules differ between the nine provinces, so one province's card is not a countrywide permit.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Visitors normally need the fishing documents required by the province and the water-right holder.

Who doesn’t

  • Vienna: children aged 6–13 can fish under an authorised adult's supervision if the adult's permit records their permission.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Vienna guest fishing cardany30 daysSee official site

Extra stamps and permits

  • Water-right holder's licence
    Normally required in addition to the provincial fishing card or guest card.

Rules visitors should know

  • Vienna guest cards cover only the waters named on the card.
  • In Vienna, carry the fishing card and show official photo ID when requested.

How to buy

Ask the provincial fisheries authority about the card. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-right holder; Vienna rights holders also issue guest cards.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Austria?

Austria normally requires a provincial fishing card or guest card, plus permission for the chosen water. Rules differ between the nine provinces, so one province's card is not a countrywide permit.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Austria?

Ask the provincial fisheries authority about the card. Obtain the water permit from the fishing-right holder; Vienna rights holders also issue guest cards.
